objective: Accretion laws over abstract names: a board grows from a seed, each step decided by the radius-r view of a site, values from a finite alphabet, every fair order counted. To be proved: (G1) a law none of whose actions closes a cycle grows only trees, so no such law grows the plane in any order; (G2) a law that names the square and carries a marker grows exactly the plane in its only order (a spiral); (G3) the square-closing law of every radius, without a marker, has a fair order whose limit is not the plane (a slit filled from both sides leaves two sheets). Checks: the spiral to many turns, the slit order and a control order for several radii.
title: Accretion needs a named face
